nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Inputs from Agent Spine: current_task (object), triggering_comment_text (string), caller_user_id (string), personal_data (boolean from PD Verifier), clickup_task_id (string). Returns: {task_comments, additional_context, sources_used, sources_filtered_out}.

nodes.name: Fetch Task Comments
nodes.notes: Step 0 (always): fetch last 30 comments on the triggering task. onError=continueRegularOutput so search continues even if comments are unavailable.

nodes.name: Has Triggering Text
nodes.notes: Skip search if no triggering comment text. False branch goes directly to Build Output with just the task comments.

nodes.name: Build Search Prompt
nodes.notes: Assembles the query-extraction prompt. Passes triggering_comment_text and task name/description to Haiku to extract search queries.

nodes.name: Extract Queries
nodes.notes: Haiku call via Invoke Model to extract search queries. triggered_by='search_step' (requires migration 009). onError=continueErrorOutput -> Alert Extract Failed -> Build Output (no search, just comments).

nodes.name: Alert Extract Failed
nodes.notes: WARN when Invoke Model call for query extraction fails. Run continues to Build Output returning only task comments.

value.message: Search (v1): wyodrębnianie zapytań przez model nie powiodło się — zwrócono tylko komentarze zadania.

nodes.name: Parse Queries
nodes.notes: Parse model JSON response into queries[]. Returns {queries: string[]}. On parse failure returns empty array (no search).

nodes.name: Has Queries
nodes.notes: Skip search loop if model returned no queries. False branch goes to Build Output.

nodes.name: Expand Queries
nodes.notes: Expand queries array into individual items so SplitInBatches can loop over them.

nodes.name: Query Loop
nodes.notes: Loop over queries one at a time (batchSize=1). Loop output -> Search Tasks -> back here. Done output -> Merge Results.

nodes.name: Search Tasks
nodes.notes: Search ClickUp tasks by query. onError=continueRegularOutput: a failed search returns an empty tasks array and the loop continues.

nodes.name: Merge Results
nodes.notes: Receives all search results from Query Loop done. Deduplicates tasks by ID and extracts unique space_ids for Layer B check.

nodes.name: Has Candidates
nodes.notes: Skip Layer B and artifact reading if no search results found.

nodes.name: Expand Spaces
nodes.notes: Expand space_ids array into individual items for Space Loop. Each item has {space_id}.

parameters.jsCode:
const { space_ids } = $json;
return space_ids.map(id => ({ json: { space_id: id } }));

nodes.name: Space Loop
nodes.notes: Loop over unique space_ids to check caller membership. Loop -> Check Space Member -> back. Done -> Layer B Filter.

nodes.name: Check Space Member
nodes.notes: Layer B: fetch space members. onError=continueRegularOutput so a failed check returns empty members -> caller excluded from that space (fail-closed).

nodes.name: Layer B Filter
nodes.notes: Layer B (ADR-004): filter candidates to only those in spaces where caller_user_id is a member. Uses Expand Spaces items (same order as space loop) to match space_ids to membership responses. Fail-closed: empty members = exclude.

nodes.name: Has Accessible
nodes.notes: Skip artifact reading if Layer B filtered out all candidates.

nodes.name: Expand Artifacts
nodes.notes: Expand accessible artifacts into individual items for Artifact Loop.

nodes.name: Artifact Loop
nodes.notes: Loop over accessible artifacts (up to 3). Loop -> Read Task -> back. Done -> Build Output.

nodes.name: Read Task
nodes.notes: Read full task content for each accessible artifact. onError=continueRegularOutput: failed reads return empty and loop continues.

nodes.name: Build Output
nodes.notes: Final node: assembles task_comments (always) + additional_context from read artifacts (when available). Uses node references with try/catch so all convergence paths work regardless of which ran.
